biological_replicate.evidence: Human milk samples (n = 6) were obtained from milk collections forming part of the MediDiet study from healthy Italian mothers aged between 25 and 40 in a period between 5 and 7 weeks postpartum.

number_of_biological_replicates.evidence: Human milk samples (n = 6) were obtained from milk collections forming part of the MediDiet study from healthy Italian mothers aged between 25 and 40 in a period between 5 and 7 weeks postpartum.

number_of_fractions.evidence: A gel of each sample was excised in six bands in a similar manner and digested using trypsin (1:50, w/w skimmed milk proteins) for 16 h at 37 °C.

number_of_samples.evidence: Human milk samples (n = 6) were obtained from milk collections forming part of the MediDiet study from healthy Italian mothers aged between 25 and 40 in a period between 5 and 7 weeks postpartum.

number_of_technical_replicates.evidence: An equal amount of stable isotope-labeled peptide mixture and PRTC peptides was spiked into three replicates of an in-solution tryptic digest of six samples.
